notes: Phase 4.5A auto-persistence is intentionally narrower than the full production allowlist.
Only verified official NSO monthly statistics can be appended automatically.
Existing logical keys are immutable; revised/conflicting values stop the run instead of overwriting history.
Partial official release bundles are allowed: verified CPI or banking-growth facts may append independently when available.
Customer rates, policy rates, daily FX/gold and interbank rates remain governed by their separate paths.
